mapper.select:
SELECT c.* FROM creation c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT creation_id, MAX(created_at) AS latest_version_at FROM creation_version WHERE deleted = false GROUP BY creation_id ) v ON v.creation_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = false
AND ( c.name ILIKE ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR c.translated_name ILIKE ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR c.author ILIKE ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR c.tags ILIKE ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') )
ORDER BY v.latest_version_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.id DESC
